title: Goonga'en Makka
intro: E balɗe gadane peeñgol, nde nulal goonga ngal fotnoo haɓde e luural mawngal, won e yontaaji ina ndarii ina njuumta e hoolaare mum en. Ɓeen gooŋɗinɓe ina kawri e tooñanngeeji ɗi miijaaka ummoraade e yiɗɓe momtude annoore iimanaagal. Torra maɓɓe ina tiiɗi, torra maɓɓe ina mawni—kono ɗemɗe maɓɓe ngoppaani bayyinde ngootaagu Alla. Hay nde ɓe mberlaa e nder luggiɗnde majjere, ndeenka Alla ina taaroo ɓe, ina wayla jarribo maɓɓe e seedantaagal goonɗinal duumingal. Njiyloɗen yahdu ɗeen yontaaji kaawniiɗi.
clues: En jarribaama e jukkungo tiiɗngo sabu en njaɓaani woppude goonɗinal men e Alla gooto
Yimɓe men mbaawaano taƴde pellital men, no tooñannge maɓɓe wontiri tagoore nii
Min ndartinaama e ɓunndu ñalnde kala, kono ballal Alla ina ɓadii sahaa kala
Tiiɗnaare amen haawnii hay seedtiiɓe muñal amen
Heewɓe e Makka njiɗnoo ko doole ngam recant, kono min keddii e tiiɗnaare
Nde fof wayi ko no majjude nii, ndimaagu men ari ko e naatgol Alla kaawis
